hypotheses.R0_degree24_recomposition_is_exact: Degree 24 has cosine at least 0.999 and relative error at most 0.02 against direct autograd at every one of 96 sites.
hypotheses.R1_degree12_gradient_replication: Degree 12 reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90 and 10th percentile at least 0.80.
hypotheses.R2_degree12_finite_coalitions_are_direct: Degree-12-selected top-64 positive coalitions increase the semantic score on at least 90% of finite patches.
hypotheses.R3_degree12_preserves_causal_strength: Degree-12 coalitions retain at least 70% of the exact-gradient coalition's mean signed finite shift.
hypotheses.R4_degree16_matches_exact_coalitions: Degree-16 directional fraction is within 0.02 and mean signed shift within 10% of the exact-gradient coalition.
hypotheses.R5_degree12_transfers_across_features: Every semantic feature has median degree-12 gradient cosine at least 0.80 and finite directional fraction at least 0.75.
hypotheses.R6_degree8_remains_an_insufficient_contr: Degree 8 has either median gradient cosine below 0.80 or finite directional fraction below 0.80.
